outcome: Operative delivery due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies diagnosed with isolated SUA (no known chromosomal/structural anomalies/fetal growth restriction) attempting vaginal delivery
finding: Isolated single umbilical artery (SUA) is associated with an increased risk for cesarean section due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate and an increased rate of small for gestational age.
mod_finding: Isolated single umbilical artery (SUA) is associated with an increased risk for cesarean section due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate.
birth_weight: Lower in the isolated SUA group
